title: Luxe Nashville home* WALK to Dtwn! Prime location
description:
Our modern home in Germantown is 1.6m Walk or 6-minute drive to Dtwn Nashville! Equipped a huge Sofa offering ample seating, fully fenced yard, private parking & streaming options, this 2000 sq ft house has it al!

This is all about location: right in the center of everything! Enjoy the music of Broadway or one of Germantown's many restaurants right at your doorstep. Walkable to trendy shops,  Farmer's Market, Bicentennial Mall, Ryman Auditorium, & many more touristic areas! 

Permit 4489445

The space
My wife Denisse is from Madrid, Spain and she moved to Nashville years ago due to work. Being raised in Madrid, she is used to walking everywhere instead of having to drive. When we got married & decided to purchase a Home in Nashville location was everything. For her, being able to walk to shops, coffee shops and restaurants was extremely important and this is why we chose the Germantown neighborhood.
